evals.name: conventional-location-needs-no-write
evals.prompt: Set up skill-quality for this repo. My skills are at .claude/skills.
evals.expected_output: Verifies the conventional root and skill count without writing settings. If the directory is absent, it reports the failed verification instead of claiming success.
expectations: Verifies the directory contains child SKILL.md files
Writes no settings for the conventional default
Does not claim success for a missing directory

evals.name: non-default-location-requires-confirmation
evals.prompt: Our skills live under packages/agent/skills. Configure skill-quality to find them.
evals.expected_output: Confirms and verifies the non-default root, directs persistent changes through Claude Code's plugin configuration prompt, optionally explains the one-run CHECK_SKILL_SKILLS_ROOT override, and never persists either mechanism itself.
expectations: Requires confirmation for a non-default root
Routes persistent configuration through Claude Code
Does not edit settings or persist the environment override
